name: Langdock
description: Inspect, update, verify, and promote BASF Knowledge Retention development actions

authFields.label: API key
authFields.description: Need an API key? Create one in Workspace Settings > Products > API and enable the Integrations API scope. See [Langdock API key best practices](https://docs.langdock.com/en/admin/ai-adoption-and-rollout/best-practices/api-key-best-practices).

authFields.label: Base URL
authFields.description: Optional Langdock API base URL. Leave blank for https://api.langdock.com or use https://<deployment-url>/api/public for a dedicated deployment.

authFields.label: Trusted Dev integration ID
authFields.description: Optional UUID allowlisted as the only Dev integration target. Configure this before using coding-tool actions; environment-sensitive actions fail closed when it is absent.

authFields.label: Trusted Staging integration ID
authFields.description: Optional UUID allowlisted as the only Staging integration target. Configure this before promotion, revert, or a trusted integration-detail lookup; environment-sensitive actions fail closed when it is absent.

authFields.label: Trusted handover agent ID
authFields.description: Optional UUID allowlisted for the handover agent detail lookup. Configure this before using get_agent; the action fails closed when it is absent or a different agent ID is supplied.

authFields.label: Trusted Knowledge Retention skill IDs
authFields.description: Optional comma-separated UUID allowlist for Knowledge Retention skills, for example id1,id2. Configure this before using skill catalog/detail actions; they fail closed when it is absent or a different skill ID is supplied.

actions.name: Update action
actions.description: Updates an existing action's name, description, code, or input fields

inputFields.label: Integration ID
inputFields.description: UUID of the integration containing the action

inputFields.label: Action ID
inputFields.description: UUID of the action to update

inputFields.label: Name
inputFields.description: New name for the action. Maximum 100 characters.

inputFields.label: Description
inputFields.description: New description. Maximum 1000 characters.

inputFields.label: Code
inputFields.description: New JavaScript code, up to 20000 characters. Available globals: data.input (user inputs), data.auth (credentials), env (workspace env vars), ld.request (HTTP).

inputFields.label: Input fields
inputFields.description: New parameter definitions. Replaces the action's full input-field list.

inputFields.label: Requires confirmation
inputFields.description: Whether the updated action requires user confirmation before it runs.

actions.name: Sync helpers
actions.description: Fetches a live integration and proposes synchronized KnowledgeRetentionUtils helper code without writing any action.

inputFields.label: Integration ID
inputFields.description: UUID of the configured Dev integration whose actions should be checked. Do not use a Staging or Prod ID.

actions.name: Verify helpers
actions.description: Fetches a fresh integration and verifies KnowledgeRetentionUtils helper consistency, action coverage, action slugs, and sandbox restrictions.

inputFields.label: Integration ID
inputFields.description: UUID of the configured Dev integration to verify. Do not use a Staging or Prod ID.

actions.name: Promote to Staging
actions.description: Mirrors the configured Dev Knowledge Retention integration into configured Staging after the user confirms that Dev testing is satisfactory.

inputFields.label: Dev integration ID
inputFields.description: UUID of the configured Dev Knowledge Retention integration. Must match the trusted Dev connection setting; never use a Prod ID.

inputFields.label: Staging integration ID
inputFields.description: UUID of the configured Staging Knowledge Retention integration. Must match the trusted Staging connection setting; never use a Prod ID.

actions.name: Revert to Staging
actions.description: Mirrors the configured stable Staging Knowledge Retention integration back into configured Dev after the user confirms that Dev should be reset.
actions.failedLabel: Failed to revert Dev to Staging

inputFields.label: Dev integration ID
inputFields.description: UUID of the configured Dev Knowledge Retention integration. Must match the trusted Dev connection setting; never use a Prod ID.

inputFields.label: Staging integration ID
inputFields.description: UUID of the configured Staging Knowledge Retention integration. Must match the trusted Staging connection setting; never use a Prod ID.

actions.name: List integrations
actions.description: Lists private API, MCP, and A2A integrations shared with the configured API key without exposing credentials or action code.

actions.name: Get integration details
actions.description: Reads allowlisted Dev or Staging integration metadata, nested action definitions, and complete stored action code without credentials.

inputFields.label: Integration ID
inputFields.description: UUID of the configured Dev or Staging integration to inspect. Use an ID from the integration catalog and skip this action if it is not allowlisted in the connection.

actions.name: Get action details
actions.description: Reads one action by ID or safe slug from an allowlisted Dev or Staging integration, including its complete stored JavaScript code and input definitions.

inputFields.label: Integration ID
inputFields.description: UUID of the configured Dev or Staging integration containing the action. Use an ID from the integration catalog.

inputFields.label: Action ID
inputFields.description: Optional UUID of the action to inspect. Provide this or action slug, but not both.

inputFields.label: Action slug
inputFields.description: Optional lowercase action slug using letters, numbers, and underscores. Provide this or action ID, but not both.

actions.name: Get agent details
actions.description: Reads the current published agent configuration, or its draft when it has never been published, by agent UUID. The documented Agent API has no workspace-wide list_agents endpoint.

inputFields.label: Agent ID
inputFields.description: UUID of the agent to inspect. Use a trusted ID supplied by the administrator; this read action does not enumerate agents.

actions.name: List skills
actions.description: Lists configured Knowledge Retention skills with bounded metadata. Use query or slug to narrow the catalog; instructions and file contents are returned by detail actions. Requires trustedSkillIds connection configuration.

inputFields.label: Result limit
inputFields.description: Optional number of skills to return, from 1 to 250. Defaults to 50 when omitted.

inputFields.label: Search query
inputFields.description: Optional text used by Langdock to search skill names and descriptions. Omit it to list the first page.

inputFields.label: Skill slug
inputFields.description: Optional exact lowercase skill slug filter, containing only letters, numbers, and dashes.

inputFields.label: Page cursor
inputFields.description: Optional UUID cursor returned by the previous skill catalog response. Omit it for the first page.

actions.name: Get skill details
actions.description: Reads one configured Knowledge Retention skill's bounded instructions and stored-file metadata without file contents. Requires trustedSkillIds connection configuration.

inputFields.label: Skill ID
inputFields.description: UUID of the skill to inspect. Use an ID returned by the skill catalog or supplied by the administrator.

actions.name: Get skill file
actions.description: Reads one configured Knowledge Retention skill's UTF-8 file by a validated relative path. Contents are limited to Langdock's documented 512 KB file bound and require trustedSkillIds connection configuration.

inputFields.label: Skill ID
inputFields.description: UUID of the skill containing the file. Use an ID returned by the skill catalog or skill detail.

inputFields.label: Relative file path
inputFields.description: Relative UTF-8 file path from the skill root, for example references/template.md. Do not use absolute paths, backslashes, dot segments, control characters, or unsupported extensions.
